# sauth_app_page (Resource)

The app_page records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) app id
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `kind` (String) page kind
- `template` (String) html/template source, an empty string removes the page
